label: MEASURED. Read-only inspection of local archives. Nothing promoted. passed stays false.
claim_under_test: The 2026-10-09 handoff states the BDB 2027 set is Combine tracking for 2023-2025 plus in-game tracking for those same players, and that it will not cover the Week 5 / Week 6 slate. The archive also contains player_play rows whose game_id begins 2026, which superficially contradicts that.
verdict: HANDOFF CLAIM CONFIRMED. The game_id prefix is a DATE, not a season.

bdb_player_play_2026_rows.interpretation: Jan-Feb 2026 is the NFL postseason concluding the 2025 season. 14 games on 2026-01-04 across all 32 teams is wild-card weekend. These are POST games of the 2025 season, not REG games of the 2026 season.

join_to_frozen_filter.raw_join_note: Expected 0 on raw id: BDB uses 10-digit YYYYMMDDNN, nflverse uses YYYY_WW_HOME_AWAY. A raw-id mismatch is not evidence of non-coverage.

coverage_of_2023_2025.note: BDB covers full REG seasons 2023-2025. The frozen filter contains 272+272+272 = 816 REG games for those seasons, so tracking coverage there is complete in principle. It is NOT verified play-by-play here.

tracking_columns.note: game_tracking carries true 10Hz-style x/y/s/a/dis/o/dir/event coordinates for 2023-2025 REG games. This is the only sanctioned in-game coordinate source available locally.

license: BDB 2027 competition data is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial). Flagged in the handoff; unresolved. Do not feed it into anything commercial until cleared.

crosswalk.note: This bridges BDB nfl_id to the gsis_id chain the rest of the repo uses.

coordinate_validation.field_geometry: x spans 0-120 yards (with end zones), y spans 0-53.3 yards
coordinate_validation.verdict: Real field coordinates with proper NFL event labels. This is a genuine 10Hz-class input plane.

actionable: 2023-2025 REG in-game tracking with x/y coordinates IS available locally and covers 1001 of 1002 games (99.9%). That is a real input plane for the vision/coordinate workstream, at weight 0.
Week 5 and Week 6 of the 2026 season have NO public coordinate source. The handoff's statement stands.
CC BY-NC 4.0 must be resolved before any commercial use.
